backend/main.mo: Defines actor with user profiles, tool listings, rental requests, chat messages, sorting helpers, and access‑controlled CRUD operations.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping features to impacted frontend files, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing prewritten summaries for numerous frontend pages, components, and utilities.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining theme variables, dark mode overrides, and base element styling.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up TanStack Router routes and wraps the app in theme and toaster providers.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Authentication button component handling Internet Identity login/logout states.
frontend/src/components/auth/RequireAuth: Wrapper that blocks access to children unless the user is authenticated, showing a login prompt.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppFooter: Footer component displaying copyright text and a caffeine.ai link.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppHeader: Renders the main site header with navigation, authentication controls, and a responsive mobile menu.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Wraps pages with a standard layout including header, footer, and main content area.
frontend/src/components/listings/BrowseF: Provides search, category, price, availability, and sorting controls for browsing tool listings.
frontend/src/components/listings/CameraC: Implements a camera interface for capturing photos, handling permissions, errors, and device support.
frontend/src/components/listings/Listing: Displays a responsive grid of tool listings with photos, category badges, and key details.
frontend/src/components/listings/OwnerAc: Shows edit and availability toggle actions for listing owners using a dropdown menu.
frontend/src/components/listings/PhotoRe: Manages adding, removing, and capturing photo references via URLs or the device camera.
frontend/src/components/messaging/Active: Displays details for a selected rental conversation and embeds the rental chat panel, showing tool info, participant roles, dates, and status.
frontend/src/components/messaging/Conver: Renders a scrollable list of rental conversations with tool titles, counterpart names, and status badges, allowing selection of a conversation.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileM: Provides a dropdown user menu showing profile info and actions like navigating to the profile page or logging out.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileS: Shows a dialog prompting new users to set up their profile, allowing entry of display name, contact info, and location.
frontend/src/components/rentals/RentalCh: Loads and displays rental messages with auto‑scrolling and supports sending new messages, with UI variants for default and messaging views.
frontend/src/components/rentals/RentalRe: Form for submitting a rental request with date validation and submission handling, redirecting users after success.
frontend/src/components/rentals/RentalSt: UI component rendering approve/decline actions for rental requests with status updates via mutation hooks.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and manages the backend actor based on Internet Identity, invalidating dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and provider managing Internet Identity authentication, login flow, stored identities, and status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for profiles, tools, rentals, and related mutations using the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS base layer and custom design tokens defining color themes for light and dark modes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point initializing React, QueryClient, InternetIdentityProvider, and global styles.
frontend/src/pages/BrowseListingsPage.ts: Page for browsing tool listings with filters, search parameters, and loading state handling.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Landing page showing hero content, feature highlights, and navigation or login actions based on authentication.
frontend/src/pages/ListingDetailPage.tsx: Displays detailed tool listing info, handles loading and missing states, and shows owner actions or rental form depending on user.
frontend/src/pages/ListingFormPage.tsx: Form page for creating or editing tool listings with validation, photo management, and submission to backend.
frontend/src/pages/MessagingPage.tsx: Shows user rental-based conversations, loading states, and active chat panel within an authenticated layout.
frontend/src/pages/MyRentalsPage.tsx: Lists the user's rental bookings with status badges, links to details, and available actions.
frontend/src/pages/MyToolsPage.tsx: Displays the user's tool listings along with alerts for pending or active rental requests and navigation to management pages.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Shows and edits the user's profile with fields for personal info, picture, and URL-driven edit mode.
frontend/src/pages/RentalDetailPage.tsx: Displays detailed information for a specific rental, including tool info, dates, status, and user-specific actions, with loading and not-found states. Determines owner/renter roles and shows relevant controls and chat.
frontend/src/pages/RequestsPage.tsx: Shows incoming rental requests for tools owned by the user, rendering each with status, links, and available actions. Includes loading and empty-state handling.
frontend/src/utils/fileToDataUrl.ts: Converts a File object into a data URL string using FileReader. Returns a promise resolving with the resulting string.
frontend/src/utils/timeOnApp.ts: Formats user join timestamps into human-readable durations and full date strings. Converts bigint timestamps from nanoseconds to milliseconds.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utilities for reading, storing, and persisting URL parameters across navigation, including support for hash-based routing. Includes helpers for sessionStorage interaction and removing parameters from the URL.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending theme colors, animations, and layout utilities, with plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Describes current project state, feature requirements, and pending requests for unifying profile view/edit flows.
